item.title: WF United Girls’ Hockey Wins 1st Ever State Championship
item.description: FARGO (KVRR) – For the 1st time in program history, West Fargo United has won the North Dakota Girls’ Hockey state championship. They win 2-1 over Grand Forks to cap off one of the greatest tournament runs in North Dakota girls’ hockey history. They beat #4 Bismarck Century, #1 Fargo North/South and #2 Grand Forks to bring home the championship....
